upToDate.description: Vertex is already on the latest version.

home.createFileDialog: Create New Markdown or Text File
home.fileExists: A file already exists at that path.
home.notMarkdown: The file must be a Markdown or text file.
home.noRecents: No recent workspaces or files yet.
home.recoveryMissing: {count} window(s) from your last session couldn't be reopened: their folder or file is gone.
home.folderExists: Something already exists at that path.

about.repoDescription: The app's open-source code on GitHub.

recovery.label: Reopen windows on launch
recovery.description: Which of the windows open when you last quit Vertex (or when it crashed) are reopened when it starts. Each comes back at its size and place, with its tabs.

language.title: Language
language.label: App language
language.description: The language of menus and the interface.

channel.label: Update channel
channel.description: The release channel Vertex updates from.
channel.loadFailed: Couldn't load channels from the update server: {error}

token.label: Channel token
token.description: Optional token for restricted channels. Stored in your system keychain.
token.saved: A token is saved in your system keychain.

theme.title: Theme
theme.previewText: Markdown, links and code use the editor fonts below.
theme.primaryDescription: Buttons, links, selection and focus rings.
theme.colorModeDescription: Light, dark, or follow the system.
theme.radiusDescription: How rounded buttons, inputs and panels are.
theme.editorMonoFontDescription: Code blocks and inline code in notes.
theme.customCssDescription: Added after Vertex's own styles. Saved when you leave the editor.
theme.customCssUntrusted: This workspace's CSS is off until you trust the workspace: it could restyle or hide anything, the trust prompt included.

view.title: View
view.showExtInNameDescription: Shows the file extension in the item name label.
view.showExtAsTagDescription: Shows the file extension as a tag at the end of the item entry.
view.showFoldArrowsDescription: Shows the folder folding arrows on the right side.
view.customFileIconsDescription: Allow displaying custom icons configured in the file.
view.customFolderIconsDescription: Allow displaying custom icons configured in the folder.
view.statusBarDescription: Display mode of the status bar.
view.selectionToolbarDescription: Show a formatting toolbar above selected text.
view.slashMenuDescription: Type / to open a menu of blocks to insert.
view.blockHandleDescription: Show a handle beside blocks to drag or move them.
view.headerHistoryDescription: Where the header shows undo and redo.
view.headerFormattingDescription: Where the header shows bold, italic, strikethrough and highlight.
view.panelsDescription: Which views each side panel has, in what order, and how you switch between them. Rearrange them here, or by dragging or right-clicking their buttons in a window.
view.panelStyleDescription: Buttons inside the panels, or icon strips at the window’s edges (click the shown view’s icon to collapse its panel).
view.panelLayoutDescription: Drag views between the sides and Hidden; right-click one to move it, hide it or add a separator.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.maxLoopIterationsDescription: Every node a run activates counts; a run that goes over stops.
workflows.maxStackDepthDescription: How deep functions may call each other.
workflows.wallClockTimeoutMsDescription: A run that takes longer stops. 0 means no limit.
workflows.confirmTrashDescription: Ask once per run before a workflow moves files to the vault trash.
workflows.trustedDescription: Workflows here run without asking. Everything else asks on its first real run.
workflows.noTrusted: Nothing yet. A workflow’s first run asks you, or add a folder or file here.
workflows.fileTrustDescription: Paths and content: a trusted file, or a trusted folder's workflows as they were when you trusted it, run only while unchanged outside Vertex; edits in Vertex keep them trusted, and a workflow added or changed elsewhere (sync, git, another app, a workflow) asks first. Paths: anything at a trusted path runs.

providers.title: AI Providers
providers.description: OpenAI-compatible APIs your model profiles can use. API keys are kept in the system keychain and never shown again.
providers.name: Name
providers.baseURLDescription: The API root, usually ending in /v1.
providers.baseURLKeyWarning: Changing the base URL removes the saved API key.
providers.baseURLInvalid: Enter an http:// or https:// URL.
providers.apiKeyDescription: Optional for local servers. Saved in the system keychain.
providers.apiKeySaved: Saved in the system keychain; it can't be shown.
providers.addModelsDescription: Choose the models model profiles can use.

models.title: Model Profiles
models.description: A model profile is a provider's model with a system prompt. Features use one of them.
models.cannotRemoveDefault: The default profile can't be removed. Choose another default in Features first.
models.name: Name
models.noModels: This provider has no models yet: add some in Providers.
models.modelMissing: {model} is no longer enabled on this provider.
models.systemPromptDescription: Sent with every request that uses this profile.
models.systemPromptPlaceholder: You are a helpful writing assistant.
models.toolsDescription: Lets chats search and read your notes, and propose edits to the open one. Turn off for models without tool calling.

features.title: AI Features
features.defaultProfileDescription: Used by every feature that doesn't choose its own.
features.sectionDescription: Which features are on, and the model profile each uses. A workspace's choices apply only when its folder is trusted.
features.untrusted: This workspace's AI feature choices don't apply until you trust it.
features.editorAssistantDescription: Ask AI in the editor: rewrite, fix, continue and more.
features.chatDescription: Chats about your notes. A chat can pin its own profile. Off hides the Chats and Chat views, Ask in chat and New Chat.
features.chatStorageDescription: Where this workspace's chats are kept. Switching leaves existing chats where they are.
features.chatModeDescription: The mode new chats start in. Read only reads your notes; Suggest proposes edits you accept or reject one by one; Write stages changes and new notes you review and apply after each reply.
features.enabledDescription: Off turns off every AI feature: the editor assistant, chat and chat titles. Your chats stay where they are.
features.chatTitlesDescription: After the first reply, the chat's model names it. Off keeps the first message as the title.

entry.toolbar: Ask AI in the selection toolbar
entry.toolbarDescription: A button beside the formatting buttons when text is selected.
entry.slashDescription: Ask AI, Continue writing and the other presets among the blocks.
entry.shortcutDescription: ⌘J opens the assistant at the cursor or on the selection.

ai.off: Assistive AI is off, so nothing here is used.

scope.label: Editing
scope.help: A workspace's own settings live in its .vertex/settings.json and override yours there.
scope.globalOnlyPage: A workspace can't change these settings; they apply everywhere.

ui.selectFile: Select a file from the left side.
ui.frontmatterErrorDescription: Something is wrong with this frontmatter. The form editor is hidden to avoid corrupting your content.

palette.newFileDescription: Creates a new Markdown file in the workspace root.
palette.newFolderDescription: Creates a new folder in the workspace root.
palette.newWorkflowDescription: Creates a new workflow in the workspace root.

ui.jumpToHeading: Jump to Level {level} Content in Editor

updateLinks.title: Update links to “{name}”?
updateLinks.description: {links} link(s) in {files} note(s) point to the old name.

workflow.noRun: Not run yet. A dry run shows what would change without touching any file.
workflow.invalid: This file isn’t a workflow Vertex can open
workflow.invalidDescription: It stays read-only here. Fix the JSON in another editor or restore it from a backup.
workflow.whichNote: Which note should it run on?

workflowCanvas.emptyHint: Press Tab, double-click or right-click to add a node, or drag one in from the library.
workflowCanvas.name: Name
workflowCanvas.usedBy: Nodes using it: {count}. Deleting removes them.

workflowTrust.title: Run “{name}” for the first time?
workflowTrust.description: Workflows can change your notes. Check what this one can do; it runs only after you trust it.
workflowTrust.noPlan: It asks you questions as it runs, so it isn’t previewed here. Use Dry run to see what it would change.

workflowTrash.title: Move files to the trash?
workflowTrash.description: “{name}” is about to move files into this vault’s .vertex/trash folder. Nothing is deleted, and you can undo the run.

index.label: Read the vault
index.description: Find notes and files, and read their text, properties and links.

fs.label: Change files
fs.description: Create, rename, move, copy, trash and edit notes. Every change can be undone.

ui.label: Ask you
ui.description: Show prompts, pickers and messages, and open notes.

if.label: If
if.description: Runs then or else, then continues on done. Values set in the branch stay visible after it.

forEach.label: For Each
forEach.description: Runs body once per item, each in its own scope, then continues on done.

try.label: Try
try.description: Runs body; if it faults, runs catch with the error message. Then continues on done. Limits and aborts can't be caught.

remainder.label: {a} mod {b}
remainder.description: What's left after dividing a by b, with the sign of b (-1 mod 3 is 2). Faults when b is 0.

now.label: Now
now.description: The date and time (ISO 8601), read once per run: every use in a run sees the same.

formatDate.label: Format {date} as {pattern}
formatDate.description: Writes date in local time, replacing YYYY, MM, DD, HH, mm and ss in pattern. Faults on a date it can't read.

replace.label: Replace {search} with {replacement} in {text}
replace.description: Replaces every occurrence, matching the text exactly.

letterOf.label: Letter {index} of {text}
letterOf.description: Counts from 0. Faults when there's no letter at index.

append.label: Append
append.description: A new List with item added at the end; the input is unchanged.

first.label: First of {list}
first.description: Faults when the list is empty.

last.label: Last of {list}
last.description: Faults when the list is empty.

itemAt.label: Item {index} of {list}
itemAt.description: Counts from 0. Faults when there's no item at index.

sort.label: Sort {list}
sort.description: A new List: numbers first, smallest first, then text alphabetically.

unique.label: Unique items of {list}
unique.description: A new List without repeats, keeping each item's first occurrence.

filter.label: Keep items of {list} where {keep}
filter.description: Works out keep once per item, where it can read item and index, then continues on then with the kept items as list.

map.label: Map {list} to {value}
map.description: Works out value once per item, where it can read item and index, then continues on then with the results as list.

dictSet.label: Set
dictSet.description: A new Dictionary with key set to value; the input is unchanged.

currentNote.label: Current note
currentNote.description: The note the workflow was run on. Run from elsewhere, it asks which note.

createNote.label: Create note {name} in {folder}
createNote.description: A new markdown note, starting with the template's text when there is one. Faults if the name is taken.

appendText.label: Append {text} to {file}
appendText.description: Adds the text at the end, on a new line.

asNote.label: {file} as a note
asNote.description: Continues on ok with the entry as a note when it is a markdown file, else on fail.

open.label: Open {file}
open.description: Opens the file in a tab. Dry runs don't.

listFolder.label: Entries in {folder}
listFolder.description: What a folder holds (empty: the vault root), by path. Extensions are comma-separated; pattern is a name or glob like *.md or Daily/**.

find.label: Find {pattern}
find.description: Entries anywhere in the vault by name (with or without extension) or glob: *.pdf matches names, Projects/**/*.md paths.

fileName.label: Name of {file}
fileName.description: The name without its folder or extension.

fileInfo.label: Info of {file}
fileInfo.description: Name with extension, extension, folder, size in bytes, and when it was created and last modified (ISO dates).

rename.label: Rename {file} to {newName}
rename.description: Renames in place and updates links to it. Without an extension in the new name, the old one stays.

move.label: Move {file} to {folder}
move.description: Moves into a folder and updates links to it. An empty folder path is the vault root.

copy.label: Copy {file} to {folder}
copy.description: Copies a file, or a folder with everything in it, keeping its name. Faults if the name is taken there.

createFolder.label: Create folder {name} in {folder}
createFolder.description: Faults if the name is taken.

trash.label: Trash {file}
trash.description: Moves to the vault's .vertex/trash folder, after asking once per run. Nothing is deleted.

getProperty.label: Property {key} of {file}
getProperty.description: A frontmatter property, or null when the note has none.

setProperty.label: Set {key} of {file} to {value}
setProperty.description: Sets a frontmatter property, creating the frontmatter if needed.

queryByTag.label: Notes tagged {tag}
queryByTag.description: Every markdown note with this tag, nested tags included. Read once per run.

addTag.label: Add tag {tag} to {note}
addTag.description: Adds it to the frontmatter tags, unless the note has it already.

removeTag.label: Remove tag {tag} from {note}
removeTag.description: Removes exactly this tag from the frontmatter tags; nested tags under it stay.

linksFrom.label: Links from {file}
linksFrom.description: The files its links point to; links to missing files are left out.

linksTo.label: Links to {file}
linksTo.description: The files that link to it (its backlinks).

askText.label: Ask {question}
askText.description: Waits for a text answer. Cancelling faults the node. Dry runs ask too.

askNumber.label: Ask for a number: {question}
askNumber.description: Waits for a number. Cancelling faults the node. Dry runs ask too.

askChoice.label: Ask {question} with choices {choices}
askChoice.description: Waits for one of the choices. Cancelling faults the node. Dry runs ask too.

askYesNo.label: Ask yes or no: {question}
askYesNo.description: Continues on yes or no. Cancelling faults the node. Dry runs ask too.

form.label: Form {title}
form.description: Asks for a text answer per field at once; answers is a Dictionary from field to answer. Dry runs ask too.

pickFile.label: Pick a file: {prompt}
pickFile.description: Waits for a file from the vault, optionally only these comma-separated extensions. Dry runs ask too.

pickFiles.label: Pick files: {prompt}
pickFiles.description: Waits for one or more files from the vault, optionally only these comma-separated extensions. Dry runs ask too.

pickFolder.label: Pick a folder: {prompt}
pickFolder.description: Waits for a folder from the vault. Dry runs ask too.

pickFolders.label: Pick folders: {prompt}
pickFolders.description: Waits for one or more folders from the vault. Cancelling faults the node. Dry runs ask too.

showMessage.label: Show {message}
showMessage.description: Shows a message and continues at once. Other values than text are shown as JSON.

ui.blockHandle: Drag to move block, click for options

ai.stale: The text changed since this was generated. Retry to use the current text.
ai.staleTool: The text changed since this was suggested.

chat.placeholder: Ask anything about your notes… Type {'@'} to attach one
chat.title: Title
chat.deleteFolderConfirm: "{folder}", its subfolders and every chat in them will be deleted for good.
chat.noModel: Chat is off or has no model. Choose one in Settings → AI Features.

vault.createDescription: This workspace's chats are encrypted inside its folder.
vault.noRecovery: There's no way to recover a forgotten password: without it, these chats can't be read.

toolsUnsupported.title: This model can't use tools
toolsUnsupported.description: {model} doesn't support tool calling, so the request was stopped. Turn tools off for this model profile and try again? You can turn them back on in the profile's settings.

tools.waiting: waiting for you in the note

rewind.title: Rewind to this reply?
rewind.description: The {count} message(s) after it will be removed, with their branches.
rewind.undo: It also undoes the changes applied from those replies: {paths}
rewind.skipped: Left {count} note(s) as they are: they changed since

context.title: Context: {title}
context.totals: {messages} messages · {calls} model calls · {input} tokens in · {output} out · {seconds} s
context.notRecorded: Not recorded: this reply is from before Vertex kept its context.

changes.title: Changes ({count})
changes.conflicts: {count} change(s) not applied: the note changed after it was staged

states.conflict: Not applied: the note changed after it was staged

waitingPlaceholder.question: Answer the question above, or type your answer here…
waitingPlaceholder.approval: Type here to decline, and say why…
